defects.claim: Tip: Keep spine long, rounding only through upper back (forward flexion, not back arch)
defects.evidence: spine:-20 (negative = BACKWARD ARCH per corrected convention) — but tip explicitly says rounding through upper back = forward flexion (positive spine). Head pitch -16° (backward tilt) when description requires chin near knee = forward head tilt (positive pitch). PR-v3 likely mis-fired: pattern matches PR-v3 spine-sign defect class (spine sign flipped wrong way).

defects.claim: Wrap both arms around the shins
defects.evidence: L-R wrist 3D distance 1.255 (should be <0.30 for wrapping close together). Wrists at y=0.68/0.82 — way above shins (y~0.4 between knees at y=0.22 and hips at y=0.12). shoulderFwdL:+30, shoulderFwdR:+30 — positive = BEHIND per corrected convention, arms go backward not forward to shins. Shoulder abducted 95°/107° (lateral, arms out to sides).

defects.claim: Rest the chin near a knee
defects.evidence: Head at (0.010, 0.889, -0.199), L knee at (-0.197, 0.225, 0.410). Head-to-L-knee 3D distance 0.924 (should be <0.30 for chin near knee). Head y=0.89 vs knee y=0.22 — vertical gap 0.67 (head far above knee). Head pitch -16° (backward) — should be +30 to +45° (forward chin-down).

regression_risk: Medium — 7 field changes including spine sign flip. Knees-up posture (hip flexion 118°, knee 130°) preserved. globalTilt:+5 preserved. Re-render verification REQUIRED to confirm (1) wrists converge near shins (target 3D dist <0.30), (2) head pitches forward enough to bring chin closer to knees (target head-to-knee <0.35, may be limited by renderer joint set).
rationale: Description requires curled-up knees-hugged pose with chin near knee — requires FORWARD flexion of upper back (rounding) to bring head down toward knees, plus both arms reaching FORWARD to wrap shins. Currently spine:-20 (BACKWARD ARCH, wrong sign — likely PR-v3 spine-sign defect), shoulderFwd:+30/+30 (BEHIND per corrected convention, arms go backward), shoulder abducted 95°/107° (lateral, arms out to sides not wrapping). Fixes: (1) Flip spine -20 → +25 (forward flexion, rounding upper back per tip; brings head forward-down toward knees — sign verified + = forward). (2) Reduce shoulder abduction -70/-82 → -30/-30 (arms from lateral to ~40°, closer to body midline). (3) Flip shoulderFwd +30 → -25 (negative=FORWARD per corrected convention, arms reach forward to shins). (4) Slight elbow reduction 100→95 (forearms wrap shins). Renderer limitation: no head-pitch joint (neck is rotZ sideways only) — chin-to-knee achieved indirectly via spine forward flexion. May not fully reach chin-near-knee target but is closest achievable.
